links.note: The apple-icon.png file visually displays the GoalSeek monogram logo mark (stylized V+Z letters in white on black background).
File resides at web/public/apple-icon.png, placing it within the web public static assets directory.
Apple touch icons (apple-icon.png in public/) are served as home-screen icons when users add the web app to their iOS device; strongly associated with the GoalSeek web application.
The monogram logo mark represents the GoalSeek product brand identity used across the web application.
The web/public directory is the standard static asset root served by the GoalSeek web application.
The 32x32 icon image visually displays the VIO/V10 logo mark in white on a dark background.
Filename explicitly includes 'dark', indicating this is the dark-theme variant of the icon.
Located in web/public/ at 32x32 pixels, a standard favicon size; likely served as a browser tab icon.

links.notes: 'v0' likely refers to the GoalSeek application branding or a versioning convention used as the product identity mark.
Filename explicitly includes 'light', indicating this is the light-theme variant of the icon.
File resides in web/public/, making it a static web asset served directly to the browser.
Light-theme icon variants are typically used in browser favicon or UI contexts where a light/dark pair is selected based on user preference.

links.note: Icon serves as the brand/app identity symbol for the GoalSeek application
The icon has a 180x180 rounded rectangle (rx=37) as background
SVG uses CSS media query prefers-color-scheme to invert colors between light and dark modes
File is an SVG vector graphic with viewBox 0 0 180 180
File is located in web/public/ directory which serves static web assets
Logomark is composed of left glyph path (Y-like shape starting at x=14)
Logomark is composed of right glyph path (S/Z-like shape starting at x=101)
CSS .foreground class fill is white in light mode and black in dark mode, applied to glyph paths
CSS .background class fill is black in light mode and white in dark mode
The two paths form a unified brand symbol together, both scaled at 95% from center
SVG format is resolution-independent and well-suited for web favicon/icon use
